pages.title: A Big Dream
pages.content:
It is Sunday morning. Yusuf and Grandpa are at the table in the kitchen. There is a big map on it. “Grandpa, where is Spain?” Yusuf asks. Grandpa shows him. “A long time ago, a man from Spain goes on a very long trip. His name is Ibn Jubayr. Do you want to hear his story?” “Yes, please!” Yusuf says.

“Ibn Jubayr lives in Granada,” Grandpa says. “It is a beautiful city in Spain. Muslims live there. Ibn Jubayr has got a big dream. He wants to go on Hajj. He wants to see Mecca and the Ka’ba. He wants to see new cities, too. One day, he takes a small diary. ‘I can write about my trip every day,’ he says.”

vocabulary.definition: A picture of countries, cities and seas.
Going from one place to another place.
A small book. You write about your day in it.

pages.title: A Storm at Sea
pages.content:
Yusuf looks at the map. “How does he go, Grandpa? By plane?” he asks.

Grandpa laughs. “No, Yusuf! There are no planes. He goes by ship,” he says. “The ship is on the sea for many days. One night, there is a big storm. The wind is very strong. The water is very high. The people on the ship are afraid. They pray to Allah. In the morning, the sea is quiet again. Everybody is safe. Ibn Jubayr writes about the storm in his diary.”

vocabulary.definition: A very big boat.
Very bad weather with strong wind and rain.

pages.title: A Free Hospital
pages.content:
“Where does the ship go, Grandpa?” Yusuf asks.

“To Egypt,” Grandpa says. “Ibn Jubayr sees a very tall lighthouse there. Then he goes to Cairo. Cairo is a very big city. The sultan there is Saladin. He is a kind and fair man. There is a big hospital in Cairo. It is free for everybody. Every day, Saladin gives bread to poor people, too. Ibn Jubayr writes all this in his diary.”

vocabulary.definition: A tall tower with a light. It helps ships at night.
A place for sick people. Doctors work there.
You do not pay money for it.

iCan: I can say: The hospital in Cairo is free.

pages.title: Eight Months in Mecca
pages.content:
Yusuf puts his finger on the map. “And then Mecca?” he asks.

“Yes!” Grandpa says. “Ibn Jubayr goes across the desert with many camels. The sun is very hot. There is not much water. The trip is very hard. Then he goes across the Red Sea by ship. At last, he comes to Mecca. He sees the Ka’ba. He is very happy. People from many countries are there. Ibn Jubayr makes the Hajj. He stays in Mecca for eight months! He writes, ‘Mecca is small, but there is a place for everybody.’”

vocabulary.definition: A very hot, dry place with sand.

iCan: I can say: Ibn Jubayr sees the Ka’ba.

pages.title: Big Cities
pages.content:
“Does he go home now, Grandpa?” Yusuf asks.

“Not yet,” Grandpa says. “He goes to Medina. Then he goes to Baghdad. Baghdad is a very big city. It has got many mosques and baths. Then he goes to Damascus. He sees the Great Mosque there. It has got beautiful walls and doors. Ibn Jubayr likes this city very much. His diary is full now.”

vocabulary.definition: Places where Muslims pray.

exercises.title: Big Cities
exercises.question: Read. Put each sentence in place.

Ibn Jubayr goes home after Mecca.

True: Ibn Jubayr likes Damascus very much.
False: Ibn Jubayr goes home after Mecca.

beforeYouRead.question: Guess: Which city has got the Great Mosque?
beforeYouRead.quote: He sees the Great Mosque there.

iCan: I can say: Ibn Jubayr goes to big cities.

pages.title: Home Again
pages.content:
Yusuf looks at Grandpa. “Is the trip back easy, Grandpa?” he asks.

“No, it isn’t,” Grandpa says. “Ibn Jubayr gets on a ship again. There are big storms again. The ship stops near an island. It can’t move! But people on the island come and help them. At last, Ibn Jubayr comes home to Spain. He thanks Allah. His trip is more than two years long. Then he writes a book from his diary. People read his book today, too.”

Yusuf runs to his room. He comes back with a small notebook. “Grandpa, I want a diary, too!” he says. Grandpa laughs. “Then let’s write about today, Yusuf!”
